additional_info.body:
Hi Eduard,
Thank you for sharing the information. I believe that this charging session is different and refers to another session, as there is a significant time gap between the two events. One possible root cause of this issue could be that there was an OCPP disconnection during that period. When the OCPP connection was re-established, the system may have sent data from the previous session.
Could you please share a screenshot from the backend where the internal error was reported?
Thank you.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0423455-DC/Si-D/DE-[ Y2 / S7 313808292008] Date and time issue CRM:02698000115
additional_info.body:
Hi
Eduard,
We have analyzed the logs and found that the internal error, which occurs frequently during charging sessions, is due to an issue with the
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
.
To address this, we strongly recommend updating the charger to the latest firmware version. After the firmware update, please monitor the charger during a charging session. If the issue continues to occur frequently, we would then recommend replacing the DC2 cable, as the problem is only happening on the DC2 connector.
Kindly let us know a specific date and time when we can perform the firmware update. Alternatively, if we observe that the charger is idle, we can proceed with the update accordingly.
Please let us know your preference.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
